product.name: Invoice Capture
product.description: A tool to digitize and categorize receipts and invoices, syncing data with accounting software for bookkeeping.

product.name: Bill Pay
product.description: A platform feature to batch pay employees, suppliers, and contractors directly from a connected bank account with approval workflows and automatic reconciliation.

product.name: Apron Card
product.description: Expense cards issued to employees with customizable spending limits and automated receipt collection for expense management.

product.name: Apple Pay Integration with Apron Card
product.description: Enables users to add their Apron Card to Apple Pay for secure, contactless payments via Apple devices.

product.name: Apron Books Club
product.description: A partner program offering rewards and benefits to accountants and bookkeepers using Apron for client bookkeeping and payments.
